sections.text: التفكيك
Pump Out Of Operation
Dismantle all attached pipes.

Unscrew the bolts of the electric motor feet 
 and take motor out .
Dismantle the pump half coupling.
Remove the air separator.

Unscrew the bolts of the two sides of bearing 
 carriers from the pump and take them out complete with bearings.

Unscrew the nut tightening the stuffing box 
 flange and withdraw flanges together with bearing.

Remove the cap body together with valve 
 distributing plate from the two sides of vacuum pump after unscrewing its 
 fastening screws.
خلع الدوار مضخة فراغ كاملة.

Remove the plotter valve by unscrewing the 
 screws in the inner side of valve distributing plate.

Check all components of the pump and replace 
 them by new ones if needed.

sections.text: حَشد

Assemble the valve distributing plates 
 (plotter valves after cleaning their openings ) with the pump cover.

Install one of the pump covers then insert the 
 shaft into it .

قم بتركيب العجلة الدائرية وشجيرات الختم 
 إلى رمح.
Install the second cover of the pump.

Mount bearings with their carriers and tight 
 them to the pump (after greasing the bearings).
Install the pump half coupling.

Screw the electric motor bolts after adjusting 
 alignment.

Repack the stuffing boxes and tight them 
 easily by hand.
Install the air separator.
Install all attached pipes to the pump.

sections.text: بدء تشغيل المضخة

Check the direction of rotation of pump before 
 starting the pump for the first time.

Check the quantity of grease in the bearing 
 sump.

Check whether the inlet for flooding the 
 stuffing box is open.

Check whether the inlet for hydraulic sealing 
 of the suspension is open.
Check whether the delivery valve is closed.

Open the delivery valve gradually after the 
 set has been started to operate at its full speed.
